However, Testimony 3 suggests that Andistan'dhin saw Ahlbi in the treasure room, implying that Ahlbi might have been the one to kill Rohl. But if Rohl was killed around noon, it's unlikely that Andistan'dhin would have seen Ahlbi in the treasure room at that exact time, as Andistan'dhin was likely busy with the Dance of Devotion ceremony. Furthermore, Testimony 5 states that before the blackout, only Ahlbi (other than Rohl) strolled to the treasure room, which could imply that the murder occurred during the blackout, not when Andistan'dhin claims to have seen Ahlbi.
